title: Pullback of an ample invertible module
statement: Let $g:Y\to X$ be an affine morphism [pqf-def-affine-morphism] of schemes [def-pc-scheme], let $\mathcal L$ be an ample [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module] invertible [def-sc-invertible-module] $\mathcal O_X$-module, and let $g^*\mathcal L$ be its pullback. Then $g^*\mathcal L$ is ample on $Y$.

proof.text: From hL and [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module], install CompactSpace X. An affine morphism is quasi-compact [lem-weil-pbc-affine-morphism-permanence, clause (3)]. Hence Y is quasi-compact by [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-morphism-permanence, clause (2)], implemented by QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace g in Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Morphisms/QuasiCompact.lean:150.

For y in Y, apply hL at g(y) to obtain n>0, a global section s of L^{tensor n}, and its affine nonvanishing open U containing g(y). Obtain t with inverse-image nonvanishing locus from [lem-weil-pbc-tensor-power-section-nonvanishing-pullback]. The open g^{-1}(U) contains y and is affine, directly by IsAffineOpen.preimage (Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Morphisms/Affine.lean:50), the definition [pqf-def-affine-morphism]. At every z, rewrite the nonvanishing locus of t to g^{-1}(X_s) and apply the given equivalence z in g^{-1}(U) iff s is nonvanishing at g(z). This supplies all witnesses of [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]. The explicit pulled-back invertibility instance in the unchanged signature is supplied by [lem-weil-pbc-invertible-pullback-tensor].
